title: Frank & Atticus – Pistachio Vanilla Latte 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Pistachio Vanilla Latte 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Pistachio Vanilla Latte is a flavour-packed vape that will take you by surprise.
Pistachio nuts and creamy milk are combined in this frothy pistachio coffee deliciousness, which is sweetened with warm vanilla beans.
The vanilla intensifies on the exhale, counteracting the undertone finish of ground coffee. This is a delicious breakfast vape that may cause you to be late for work!
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
